entries.40185d9965bc72f0: These are item-based and monthly billing income and advertising income from titles that the company distributes directly through platforms. They include the original title "Crash Fever" and the joint business title "Pandorando" with GAME FREAK inc. Revenue for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥1,155 million.

entries.b92d1024eb351a57: This is a single segment that plans, develops, operates and sells mobile games. It provides original titles developed in-house and joint business titles with collaboration partners. Revenue for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥2,316 million.
entries.bbd7bc770f652e8a: This is revenue from development and operation of joint business titles with collaboration partners and of other companies' IP titles, and includes profit sharing, success fees and consideration for development and operation. Examples include development of "Jump+ Janburu Rasshu," for which the partner handles production and distribution, and jointly developed titles with Bushiroad Inc. Revenue for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥1,161 million.
